verdicts.evidence: repro/A6d-verify/a6d.test.ts 'A6d-01 total cost box' (3 tests pass, run.log). It runs the onChange handler and value expression copied verbatim from apps/frontend/src/pages/SubmitForm.tsx:641-648. Qty 1, typing 1,5,0 shows ['1.00','1.00','1.00'] and unitCost stays 1. Qty 3, typing '1' shows '0.99'. Backspacing to empty keeps '1.00', because an empty string parses to NaN and the handler returns early.
verdicts.reason: The value prop is derived as (qty*unitCost).toFixed(2), so each keystroke is re-rendered as a 2-decimal total. The next digit lands after the decimals ('1.005'), which rounds back to 1.00, and React re-asserts the controlled value. The repro models the controlled-input loop and does not drive a real DOM, but React's number-input update (node.value != value, so it resets) produces the same result. Typing a lot total doesn't work; typing a unit cost does, so P2 stands.

verdicts.evidence: apps/frontend/src/MobileApp.tsx:536-552: onSaveLine's only guard is capture.phase !== 'form'. On the returnTo 'detail' path (set by openOrderLineForm at :720-728, used by startAddLine) backToDetail is true, so no setCapture runs before the awaited enqueueWrite. Phase stays 'form' until doneToDetail() runs after the PATCH lands (:553-558, :636-641). SubmitForm.tsx:707: the Add item button has no disabled/busy prop, and SubmitForm gets no saving prop (MobileApp.tsx:881-905; only OrderReview gets saving={pendingWrites>0} at :916). A second tap queues a second PATCH {addLines:[toAddLine(line)]} for the same line with no id or idempotency key, then flushLinePhotos for that new id.
verdicts.reason: The code path holds; I did not drive it in a browser (no DOM test harness in the frontend). The write queue serialises the two PATCHes but doesn't dedupe them, and the backend appends on every addLines. A duplicated line is phantom stock and double cost on a real PO, so P2 stands.

Backend apps/backend/src/routes/home.ts:85 sends next_follow_up_at as to_char(...,'YYYY-MM-DD') of a DATE column (migrations/0113:52); tracking_eta is TIMESTAMPTZ (0094:13).

verdicts.evidence: repro/A6d-verify/a6d.test.ts 'A6d-05' (pass). reviewMoney on the claim's fixture gives commission -2: revenue 108 minus the full cost 112 (all lines plus fees), times 0.5. A mirror of the backend formula from apps/backend/src/lib/po-cost.ts:120-125, SUM((sell_price - effUnitCost)*qty) where a NULL sell_price drops out and fees are cost-weighted (effUnitCost :49-55), clamped with GREATEST(.,0) as at routes/home.ts:40, bankTx.ts:1263, accounting.ts:292 and services/poRealized.ts:49, gives projected profit 60.00 and commission 30.00. A fully priced PO below cost shows -2 on the page and 0 on the backend. The same unclamped formula is at DesktopEditOrder.tsx:696-701.
verdicts.reason: The two formulas do diverge as claimed. The claim's approximate figures (+$56 / $28) are slightly off: the exact backend figures are $60 / $30. A manager approving sees a payout that differs from what Accounting, Home and bank matching treat as owed. That is a real money-display defect in a supported flow, so P2 stands.
